paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Astrophysical (non-DM) bound from magnetic white dwarf polarization at Lick/Keck. Best limit from MWD J033320: |g_agamma| < 1.7e-12 GeV^-1 (95% CL), nearly mass-independent for m_a < 2e-7 eV (signal suppressed at higher masses). Encoded as horizontal flat line spanning the low-mass validity range. Other MWDs give weaker limits (1.6e-11 to 4.2e-12). No dark matter assumption—relativistic axions produced in stellar B-field. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 28)) | Vision: Traced the red curve (j033320+000720 Lick), the most constraining limit and this work's primary result.
